items.title: Conditional Zariski Gersten exactness for a semistable node
items.author: Morten Lüders
items.work: Bloch-Ogus theory for smooth and semi-stable schemes in mixed characteristic
items.difficulty_reason: Beyond the smooth base theorem, the author constructs the two blow-up charts, kills the exceptional-divisor contribution using the exact stated A1-effaceability hypothesis, passes from global flat cycles to arbitrary neighborhoods using henselianity, and establishes the remaining injectivity by successive localization at the two generic special-fiber points. This additional global-to-local blow-up argument is substantive and not a direct corollary of smooth exactness.
